$comment: The core test matrix of the focus round (docs/FOCUS.md section 6). One row per core interaction. `feature` names the section 2 feature the row belongs to, so the rule "a core feature with a not driven or failed row is parked for the ship" is computed from this file by the run and never typed. `today` is what the focus audits saw on production at ec61c6b on 2026-09-15: works, broken, flaky or not driven; a not driven row carries no severity and a works row carries none either (a `note` records where the row's criterion differs from the audit's). `severity` sits on broken and flaky rows only, as the audits set it. `evidence` names the audit row or the file. `driver` names what drives the row: the editor walk probe in --core mode, or the spec file under apps/studio/e2e/core/. `setup` names a window API write made before the driven steps and never counted as one. Interaction texts carry the time bound the run checks. Rendered into docs/FOCUS.md by docs/gslides-parity/focus/render-focus.mjs; the probe's --core mode reads the ids. The rows the return round added (docs/RETURN.md section 5; the features tables, charts, diagrams, wordart, formatting, chrome, view and inbox, and the rows added under the existing areas) carry `today` as the return audits under docs/gslides-parity/return/ and the drive measured it on 2026-09-18 and cite them. `parks` on a row names the data-control ids (menu rows or toolbar controls of packages/chrome/src/menus/model.ts and toolbar-tails.ts) that row alone guards: a red row with `parks` keeps those ids behind the Advanced tools switch for that ship and neither parks its feature nor blocks the ship (RETURN.md section 1 rule 2); a red row without `parks` parks a parkable feature whole or blocks the ship when its feature is unparkable. The product round (docs/PRODUCT.md section 8) added 133 rows on 2026-09-19 under the areas of sections 2 to 6 and the four new features brand, fonts, templates and assist: `today` is what the product audits under docs/gslides-parity/product/ saw on production at 6e15d60 on 2026-09-19 (a row of a control that does not exist is not driven and cites the audit item that measured its absence; a control drawn disabled on purpose is not driven, never broken), the severity of a broken row follows the audit item's value (5 and 4 give 3, 3 gives 2, 2 and 1 give 1), and `measure` marks a measurement row (8.2) that records its seconds per slide in the run and never holds the ship. The sync and costs round (docs/SYNC.md section 6) added 16 rows on 2026-09-21 under the two unparkable features `sync` (the write path: the order, the latency, the two person title and block rows, the viewer, the reload, undo after a remote op, the idempotent resend, the pull without a listing) and `cost` (the function requests a minute a page makes and the store calls a minute the deck costs, per state): `today` is what the ordering and cost audits under docs/gslides-parity/sync/ saw on production at cbd4495 on 2026-09-20, the severity of a broken row follows the audit item's value by the product round's rule, a `sync.*` row of two browsers repeats its exchange three times inside its test, the driver `cost-probe` is scripts/probes/sync-cost-probe.mjs (run by the gate), and a cost row carries `measure: true` in the sense of SYNC.md 6.1: its counts are written beside its ceiling in the run and it holds the ship only when it is over its ceiling on the preview (the ceilings sit at about 1.5 times the model's expected count and under today's measured count, question 4's default). A row whose claim needs a lane's half names the lane in its note, so a red row on a tree where the half is not merged reads as a known mechanism (6.2). The features round, ship one (docs/FEATURES.md 7.1) added 71 rows on 2026-09-22 under the new parkable feature `logos` and the existing tables, charts, diagrams, shapes, wordart, arrange, brand, fonts, formatting, images and export: `today` is what the four production audits under docs/gslides-parity/features/ saw at 9293df4 on 2026-09-20 in the four words (a row of a control that does not exist is not driven and cites the audit item that measured its absence; the severity of a broken row follows the audit item's value by the product round's rule), `note` carries the ship and the tier (Ship one P0 or P1) with the lane whose item the row measures and the FEATURES.md section, `parks` names the control ids of FEATURES.md the row alone guards (a dialog, overlay or panel control named there is hidden through packages/chrome/src/parked-controls.ts, whose set core-matrix.mjs --emit-parked writes from the ship's parkedRows), and a row whose id area is `logos` while its measurement belongs to an unparkable feature carries that feature (`logos.export.pdf-pptx-crisp` is export, `logos.intake.*` are images; ROW_FEATURE in core-matrix.mjs), so a red one blocks the ship instead of parking the picker. The 29 rows of ship two (the shader library, FEATURES.md 5) join the file with that ship.
